question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Baroque
solution:
The correct answer is: **Plain**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Baroque"** refers to a style characterized by elaborate ornamentation and complexity, often associated with art, architecture, and music from the Baroque period. (बहुत अलंकृत)

 
 
• **Example:** The baroque design of the cathedral featured intricate carvings and gold details.
 
 
 
• **"Plain"** refers to something simple, without any elaborate decoration or ornamentation. It is the antonym of baroque. (सादा)
 
 
• **Example:** The plain white walls of the room gave it a minimalist aesthetic.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Baroque'** is **'Plain'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Plain**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Florid** (अत्यधिक अलंकृत): Excessively intricate or ornate.

 
 
• **Example:** His florid writing style made the text difficult to follow.
 
 
 
• **Ornate** (सजावटी): Decorated with complex patterns or elaborate details.
 
 
• **Example:** The ornate mirror in the hallway caught everyone's attention.
 
 
 
• **Gilt** (सोने का पानी चढ़ा हुआ): Covered with a thin layer of gold or resembling gold.
 
 
• **Example:** The gilt frame added a luxurious touch to the painting.
